CustomField.description: Named Credential used for the Microsoft Graph callouts. The message is sent by the Microsoft 365 account that authorized it, in a 1:1 chat with each recipient. Empty: MicrosoftGraph.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave empty to send from the usual Microsoft Graph account (Named Credential MicrosoftGraph). Fill only to send from the account of another Named Credential.
CustomField.label: Named Credential
